free_tier.stated: 500 calls in total, of which 1000/month and 100/day are sub-allowances: '总免费额度 500 次, 每月免费额度 1000 次 包含在总免费额度, 每日免费额度 100 次'. Free users are throttled to 3 seconds per request.

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable: the resolver returns a URL, it does not store the object. The 123云盘 endpoint notes that large files need the sharing account to hold VIP.

retention.stated: Not applicable: no bytes are stored by the resolver.

egress.terms: The API returns a resolved URL; the bytes come from the pan's own CDN. Charges are per call, not per byte: 0.0010 元/次 on balance, 0.00088 元/次 in the largest pack.

record.interface_detail: HTTP GET, JSON response, key in the query string: https://api2.wer.plus/api/123pan?key=...&url=...
record.tooling: Any HTTP client. Priced per call, so the cost is knowable before a run; QPS 10 for paying users.
record.chaining: The metered alternative to a self-run resolver: 1,000,000 resolutions for ¥880 is a fixed cost that does not depend on how much is downloaded.

limits.value: free 3s/request; paid 10 QPS; 10,000 requests/day per user

identity_cost.detail: A console account issues the key. The signup form was not read, so the exact field set is unconfirmed; no phone gate is visible in the docs.

record.reliability_note: Coverage is narrow: 123云盘, 蓝奏云, 蓝奏云优享版 and OneDrive are documented. Baidu, Quark, UC, 115 and 迅雷 are absent from the catalogue, which is the mirror image of netdisk-fast-download's paid tier.
record.confidence_note: The price table, the free allowance, the rate limits and the endpoint were read off the vendor's own doc page. No key was issued and no call was made.

evidence.proved: '参考价格 0.001元/次'; packs 100次¥0.1 to 1000000次¥880; '免费额度 500'; '每日限制 10000次'; '请求频率限制 1秒10次'; endpoint https://api2.wer.plus/api/123pan
蓝奏云直链解析 on the same platform, 免费额度 1000, '直链有效期较短，记得及时使用'

record.price_per_tb_month: CNY 880 per 1,000,000 resolutions; CNY 0.00088 per call
record.notes: Its catalogue is the map of which Chinese pans still allow a third-party resolver to mint a direct link: 123 and 蓝奏 yes, Baidu/Quark/UC/115 no.
record.binding_note: Calls, not bytes, bind: 1 TiB of monthly transfer is one call per file, so a large library is cheap and a large single file is free. The free tier's 3s/request is the only wall.
